title: Glass Ducky
body:
"Don't drop it. Also, don't steal it!!! Dugg worked hard on that!"

Description

The Glass Ducky is an almost transparent special item that can be found in a hidden room within the attic of Dugg's Digging.

It is free and can be obtained if the player is able to retrieve it from the attic without destroying it; a hard task to accomplish since it is made out of glass and thus is extremely fragile. Dropping it or colliding it with other objects will cause it to shatter.

A glass duck will become an Adult if you place it in the Duck Shrine. Unlike a normal glass duck, the adult ones are completely indestructible; they can never shatter from any impact regardless of how hard the impact is.

Obtaining

Stealing the Glass Ducky is a difficult task and can be very time consuming. The player must navigate the duck through a narrow pathway in a room cramped with shelves, barrels and crates and back out from where they came from.

A quicker; or perhaps more efficient method to obtain the Glass Ducky is by utilizing the hole near the stairs and carefully placing it on the barrel beneath the stairs, drop down, then proceed to grab it again and carefully move it through the hole you came from, and then carefully drop your way down and proceed to walk out of the store.

The Mini Crate is recommended for taking the Glass Ducky home to your base, as it cannot shatter when it is inside. The Duckie can still break if the crate is dropped from a high distance or flipped upside down in some cases.

A pillow can be used in the bottom of the inside of crates to prevent them from breaking as easily.

When trying to turn the Glass Ducky into an Adult Glass Ducky, you can put in the Duck Shrine, the same place where Baby Ducks go; however, be aware of the narrow passageway and especially the lantern at the entry of the Duck Shrine, you need to be very careful as you move it through, and it could easily be destroyed if you're not careful.

(tip, when the glass duck is in the box and you're putting the duck on the shrine, do not remove it from the box and risk breaking it, instead put the entire box on the shrine and never take it out until it's an adult)

Trivia

  • There are boxes within the same room that contain Glass Duckys with red text which claims it is "not for sale" but inspecting it will show the price of $999,999,999 Money which is extremely difficult, if not nearly impossible to obtain.
  • Unlike normal glass, you CANNOT dye the Glass Ducky (Bummer, I know)
  • A player named Godkingman292 has an astonishing mini 38 crates with 4 duckies per crate. It would take an astonishing amount of time to do this. He is able to do this because he has no life other than him playing Oaklands.
